title: observability: token/KV cost & latency dashboards + alert tuning
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Token-level billing and KV-cache behavior have become primary drivers of per-request cost and tail latency variability for a subset of enterprise workloads. Existing dashboards surfaced per-route averages but did not correlate token-level cost, KV cache hit patterns, and trace-level latency breakdowns. This PR adds a set of dashboards and revised alerting thresholds to give SREs and platform owners actionable signals to tune batching, caching, and routing policies.

What this PR does: adds new Prometheus/Datadog metrics (token_cost_usd, token_latency_ms, kv_cache_hit_ratio by model & tenant), tracing spans for KV cache lookup + cache fill, a set of Grafana dashboards for token-level cost/latency breakdowns, and updates alert rules to reduce noise while catching regressions in tail latency or sudden cost deltas.

Key changes: summarized below (code & config changes). Includes rollout plan and runbook updates as part of the change.

Impact: Improves visibility into unit economics and tail behavior. Initial dashboards target internal SRE & Platform teams; public-facing summaries will follow after a short evaluation period. No behavioral changes to serving logic are included in this PR.

Testing: unit tests for metric emission, integration tests in perf-canary cluster, manual verification on staging using synthetic traffic with KV cache warm/cold states. CI runs include lint, unit, integration (canary), and e2e dashboard rendering checks.

Rollout: feature toggled off by default for tenants; onboarding doc and runbook provided. Alert tuning will be staged: mute for 1 week, then unmute with adjusted thresholds and auto-snooze disabled.

Notes: This is a follow-up to ENG-4281 (initial token observability), consolidating KV cache signals and updating alerting after the Dedicated rollout.
commits: Add token_cost_usd and token_latency_ms metrics and labels (model, tenant, route)
Instrument KV cache: emit kv_cache_lookup_time_ms, kv_cache_hit (0/1), kv_cache_fill_time_ms
Add tracing spans: kv_lookup and kv_fill, tagged by model/tenant
Grafana: new dashboards - Token Cost & Latency Breakdown, KV Cache Heatmap, Token-level Traces
Alerting: tuned alert rules for p95/p99 token latency and sudden token_cost delta (30%/5m)

Maya Chen (author): Added a section in docs with cardinality guidance and examples; metric export limits enforced via telemetry-layer mapping (see token_metrics.py comments).
Priya Patel: Alert thresholds look reasonable. Recommend adding a temporary mute period and a dashboard widget showing alert noise rate so we can iterate post-rollout.
Maya Chen: Added mute schedule to alert config and a small Grafana panel to show alert firing count over time.
Evan Zhang: Integration tests flaked once on canary; what was root cause?
Maya Chen: Flake was due to test harness timing; increased synthetic traffic ramp and added a retry/assert window. Reran canary, CI passed.
release_notes:
- Added token-level cost and latency metrics (token_cost_usd, token_latency_ms)
- Instrumented KV cache with hit/miss metrics and traces
- New Grafana dashboards for token & KV observability
- Tuned alerting rules to reduce noise and catch regressions in tail latency and cost
